name: create_project
description: Creates a new Stitch project. A project is a container for UI designs and frontend code.

title.description: Optional. The title of the project.

name: get_project
description: Retrieves the details of a specific Stitch project using its project name.

name.description: Required. Resource name in format projects/{projectId}.

name: list_projects
description: Lists all Stitch projects accessible to the user.

filter.description: Optional filter, e.g. view=owned or view=shared.

name: list_screens
description: Lists all screens within a given Stitch project.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to list screens for, without projects/ prefix.

name: get_screen
description: Retrieves the details of a specific screen within a project.

name: generate_screen_from_text
description: Generates a new screen within a project from a text prompt.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to generate screen for.

prompt.description: Required. Text description of the screen to generate.

deviceType.description: Device form factor for screen layout.

modelId.description: Optional model to use for generation.

designSystem.description: Optional design system asset id to reuse (e.g. assets/123456).

name: edit_screens
description: Edits existing screens within a project using a text prompt.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID containing screens to edit.

selectedScreenIds.description: Required. The screen IDs to edit (without screens/ prefix).

prompt.description: Required. Edit instructions or modifications to perform.

name: generate_variants
description: Generates design variants of existing screens within a project.

selectedScreenIds.description: Required. Screen IDs to generate variants for.

name: download_file
description: Downloads the content of a screen file: its HTML code or screenshot.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the file (projects/{project}/files/{file}).

name: download_assets
description: Downloads screens and assets to a local directory.

name: list_design_systems
description: Lists all design systems associated with a project.

name: apply_design_system
description: Applies a design system to a list of screen instances.
